_about: Public-domain Alexander Jolly (1756-1838), Bishop of Moray in the Scottish Episcopal Church, for the Word Hoard: The Christian Sacrifice in the Eucharist (1831) and Observations upon the Sunday Services and Principal Holydays (1840), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
